_comment_email: RESEND_API_KEY is an Edge Function secret only — never ship it to the Flutter client.
_comment_auth_local: LOCAL DEV: flutter run -d chrome --web-port=56512. Supabase Site URL = http://localhost:56512. Redirect allow-list = http://localhost:*/** and http://127.0.0.1:*/** (covers /verify-email, /reset-password, /auth/callback). Open Confirm / reset links on the SAME PC.
_comment_auth_production: AFTER Flutter is live: Site URL = https://hdhomesltd.com. Redirect URLs = https://hdhomesltd.com/**. Release builds use https://hdhomesltd.com/verify-email and /reset-password.
_comment_phone_otp: Phone SMS OTP is disabled. Phone from registration/profile is treated as on-file (phone_verified). No Twilio/SMS provider required for portals.
